# Erdos.p241 — Erdős problem 241

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/241
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/241.lean`, theorem `erdos_241.variants.generalization`, AMS 5).

More generally, Bose and Chowla [BoCh62] conjectured that the maximum size of
$A\subseteq \{1,\ldots,N\}$ with all $r$-fold sums distinct (aside from the trivial coincidences)
then $\lvert A\rvert \sim N^{1/r}.$

## Statement
∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≥ 2), BoseChowlaConjecture r

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
